name: agent-harness
description: A security-first TypeScript harness for routed, tool-using AI agents.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-runtime-assets.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint gateway security runtime router sandbox session skills tools ui verification vfs domains ingestion harness.ts index.ts scripts benchmarks
scripts.test:unit: vitest run tests/gateway tests/policy tests/security tests/capability tests/state-machines tests/runtime tests/router tests/vfs tests/session tests/tools tests/evidence tests/verification tests/ingestion tests/packaging
scripts.test:integration: vitest run tests/integration tests/domain tests/tools/tool-executor.test.ts tests/session/file-persistence.test.ts
scripts.test:security: vitest run tests/threat-model tests/gateway tests/policy tests/security tests/capability tests/sandbox tests/tools/execute-command-security.test.ts tests/tools/read-file-security.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: vitest run tests/contracts tests/api tests/domain tests/integration tests/glm-acceptance
scripts.format: prettier --write gateway security index.ts tests *.config.* *.json scripts
scripts.verify:phase1:local: npm run typecheck && npm run check:cycles && npm run build && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:mutation:phase1
